items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember talking with Teddy Wilson for quite sometime, he was really nice.

ctx.x: Did you ever hang out with any of the musicians? Or talk to them?
No, well we tried to. Occasionally we would be lucky enough to link up with some, you know, somebody from. I remember talking with Teddy Wilson for quite sometime, he was really nice.
And were there many after-hours places?
